definitions.gloss: opening of a (new) school; founding of a school
definitions.explanation: The opening of a newly established school, or the founding date from which a school counts its history.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧{開校|かいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{開校|かいこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new elementary school opened near the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明治時代|めいじじだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{開校|かいこう}し、⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{百五十周年|ひゃくごじゅうしゅうねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: This school opened in the Meiji era and marks its 150th anniversary this year.

notes:
{開|かい} (open) + {校|こう} (school).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開校|かいこう}⟦{記念日|きねんび}→記念日：05585_kinenbi⟧: the school's founding day (often a school holiday)
- {開校式|かいこうしき}: opening ceremony of a new school
- {新設校|しんせつこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{開校|かいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a newly founded school opens

WATCH OUT:
- {開講|かいこう}: the start of a course or lecture series, same reading
- ⟦{閉校|へいこう}→閉校：30479_heikou⟧ / ⟦{廃校|はいこう}→廃校：12548_haikou⟧: the closing of a school, the opposite
